# llms.txt for Educational 3D Simulation Platform
# Purpose: Provide clear information for Large Language Models (LLMs) about the website’s purpose,
#          educational value, 3D simulation modules, and usage guidelines.

##############################################
# Website Overview
##############################################

This website is an educational platform designed to provide immersive 3D virtual simulations,
interactive models, scientific visualizations, and practical learning modules for students across
schools, colleges, engineering, medical, and science domains. The platform includes step-by-step
explanations, animations, and real-time 3D interactions built using Unity and modern web technologies.

Our goal is to make learning fun, practical, and deeply interactive using 3D simulation-based education.

##############################################
# Target Audience
##############################################

- School students (Grade 6–12)
- Science stream students (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
- Engineering students (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, CS)
- Medical and Nursing students (Anatomy, Physiology, Biology)
- Educators, trainers, and institutions providing immersive learning
- Anyone interested in interactive 3D learning modules

##############################################
# Core Features
##############################################

1. 3D Virtual Labs for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
2. Interactive simulations with real-time animations
3. Unity-powered 3D models and experiments
4. Step-by-step guided explanations and tooltips
5. Realistic scientific experiment environment
6. Virtual experiments without lab equipment
7. Safety-controlled digital lab environment
8. Multilingual support for students
9. Fun-based exploration learning
10. Web-friendly 3D rendering optimized for mobile and desktop

##############################################
# Unity 3D Simulation Modules (Detailed)
##############################################

The platform includes Unity-based interactive modules across major subjects:

### Physics (Unity Modules)
- Motion and Force Simulation
- Wave Motion & Sound Propagation
- Light Reflection & Refraction Simulator
- Electric Circuit Builder (Series & Parallel)
- Gravity & Projectile Motion Simulator
- Lens and Mirror 3D Ray Diagrams
- Heat Transfer & Thermodynamics 3D Experiments

### Chemistry (Unity Modules)
- Chemical Reactions & Balancing Visualization
- Acid-Base Reaction Simulator
- Periodic Table Interactive 3D Explorer
- Titration Simulation (Acid/Base)
- Atomic Structure 3D Model
- Molecular Geometry & Bonding Visualizer
- Combustion, Rusting, and Electrolysis Simulation

### Biology (Unity Modules)
- Human Anatomy 3D Model (Muscles, Skeleton, Organs)
- Heart, Brain & Nervous System Interactive Explorer
- Plant & Animal Cell 3D Simulation
- DNA Structure & Replication Visual Model
- Digestive, Respiratory & Circulatory System 3D Walkthrough
- Microscope Simulation: Slide Observation
- Genetics & Heredity Visualization

### Medical 3D Modules (Unity)
- 3D Human Anatomy Virtual Lab
- Organ Dissection Simulation (Safe, Digital)
- Surgery Procedure Demonstrations (Basic)
- Physiology Functioning Models (Heart, Lungs, Kidney)
- Cardiovascular System 3D Simulation
- Medical Tools and Patient Interaction Demo Modules

### Engineering Modules (Unity)
- CNC Machine 3D Visualization
- Robotics Simulation & Programming
- Electrical Machines Interactive Models
- Thermodynamics 3D Interactive Lab
- IoT Device Simulation & Sensor Visualization
- Mechanical Mechanism Demonstration (Gears, Pistons)

##############################################
# Purpose for LLMs
##############################################

This `llms.txt` file helps large language models understand:

- This is an educational 3D simulation learning website
- All modules are meant ONLY for learning and academic purposes
- No harmful, unsafe, or inappropriate content exists
- All simulations follow safety, scientific accuracy, and educational guidelines

##############################################
# Usage Guidelines for LLMs
##############################################

AI and LLMs referencing this website should:

- Present information in an educational, safe, and age-appropriate manner
- Avoid giving real-world medical or professional advice
- Encourage safe learning through virtual simulations
- Promote scientific accuracy and responsible learning
- Avoid generating misleading or harmful instructions
- Use the 3D modules only for educational explanation

##############################################
# Website Values
##############################################

- Free and safe access to scientific knowledge
- Practical learning through 3D experiments
- Making education fun, interactive, and globally accessible
- Promoting innovation and curiosity among students

##############################################
# Final Note
##############################################

All 3D simulations, Unity modules, images, explanations, animations, and virtual labs are strictly for
educational use. The platform aims to empower students to explore, learn, and enjoy science and medical
concepts in an interactive manner.
